name: Eggs in the Nest
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Beat to a froth the whites of 6 eggs, a little pepper and salt.
Pour into a buttered baking tin.
Dip upon it 6 tablespoons nice cream, 1 only in a place.
Upon each spoonful of cream drop 1 of the yolks whole (being careful not to break them).
Place in moderately hot oven to cook, and serve hot as omelet.

source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat to a froth the whites of 6 eggs, a little pepper and salt.
2. Pour into a buttered baking tin.
3. Dip upon it 6 tablespoons nice cream, 1 only in a place.
4. Upon each spoonful of cream drop 1 of the yolks whole (being careful not to break them).
5. Place in moderately hot oven to cook, and serve hot as omelet.
